name: close
source:
//@version=6
strategy("F1 parity probe", pyramiding = 0, calc_on_every_tick = false, calc_on_order_fills = false, process_orders_on_close = false, default_qty_type = strategy.fixed, default_qty_value = 1, initial_capital = 1000000)
bool f1_bool = "a" == 1
float f1_leaf_715 = f1_bool ? close : -1.0
float f1_signal_715 = float(f1_leaf_715) + (0.11)
float f1_qty_715 = 1.0 + math.abs(nz(f1_signal_715, -0.75)) % 7.0
var string f1_active_715 = ""
var string f1_value_715 = ""
if bar_index % 20 == 5 and strategy.position_size == 0
    f1_value_715 := str.tostring(f1_signal_715)
    f1_active_715 := "f1-" + f1_value_715
    strategy.entry(f1_active_715, strategy.long, qty = f1_qty_715)
if bar_index % 20 == 15 and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close(f1_active_715, comment = f1_value_715)
